workflow_description: Extracts Amazon Category Best Sellers using ScrapeHero, unpacks product_listings, and appends rank, ASIN, product name, rating, and price to Google Sheets.
business_benefits: Identify fast-moving and trending products across key Amazon categories in real time.
Monitor competitor ranking shifts and pricing movements automatically.
Eliminate manual catalog checks with scheduled automated extractions.
Build proprietary historical Best Seller Rank (BSR) datasets for predictive analytics.
Fuel e-commerce inventory and restocking decisions with structured market signals.
